What it means: The hearing focused on proposed legislation aimed at increasing tenant protections and establishing a public registry or list to hold non-compliant landlords accountable [02:03], [04:38], [06:05]. The measures address retaliatory conduct, habitability violations, inspection frequencies, and enforcement mechanisms for properties with repeated code infractions or unpaid fines [05:12], [06:32], [06:45], [06:56]. Public testifiers described recurring issues with building maintenance, mold, pests, and safety hazards, arguing that stronger city oversight is needed [1:23:43], [1:53:46], [2:12:39].

Who moved it: The matter was sponsored by Councilor Flynn [02:26], [02:37] alongside Councilor Braden, who partnered on the effort [02:57], [03:15]. Chief of Operations Deon Irish [07:48] and Inspectional Services Department official Tony D'Isidoro [07:52] provided testimony on city inspection workloads, administrative procedures, and enforcement limitations [14:47], [17:47], [2:24:36].

What to watch: City councilors and department officials noted that further discussions will take place in working sessions to address enforcement rules, corporate ownership identification, and penalty structures [16:37], [45:37], [46:14]. The transcript records the public hearing discussion but does not contain a final vote or settle whether specific ordinance amendments will be adopted.

summary: The council held a hearing on a proposed ordinance to establish a worst landlords list and increase tenant protections against chronic property code offenders [02:03], [03:19]. City officials from Inspectional Services, including Chief of Operations Deon Irish, detailed existing code enforcement protocols, inspection limits, data tracking systems, and legal proceedings for uncorrected housing violations [07:48], [12:19], [42:42]. Members of the public, tenant advocates, and legal organizations testified about severe living conditions, unaddressed repairs, and fear of retaliation, expressing support for public landlord registries and stricter city enforcement tools [1:23:18], [1:53:26], [2:54:48]. No formal votes were taken during the hearing.
